title: Elon Musk Faces an A.I. Dilemma at SpaceX
summary: Mr. Musk’s SpaceX is renting out computing power from its data centers to competitors, including Anthropic. That’s making it harder for his own A.I. effort.
caption: A data center in Southaven, Miss. Elon Musk has spent billions building data centers to catch up with rivals.

title: Audra Fordin Fixes Cars, and Eases Women’s Fears
summary: Audra Fordin recognized an undeniable need to make automobile education more accessible, and did something about it.

title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia, Showing What Trump Will Do for AI
summary: President Trump intervened on behalf of the returning Nvidia chief in a bid to boost a key company driving the stock market. The company’s share price soared.
caption: Jensen Huang was reinstated Monday as Nvidia’s chief executive. On social media, President Trump said Nvidia needed Mr. Huang, and the United States needed Nvidia.
authors: Tony Romm, Sydney Ember and Colby Smith
